title: 第11章 太乙真气
slug: 道君全本免费-道君最新章节列表
content_zh:
牛有道指了指他手上，那意思是这不现摆着么，肯定有。
宋衍青立马一脸热情，“小师弟，快把你老师写过的诗词一块儿写出来，趁着空闲，好好鉴赏一下。”
牛有道摇头：“师父临终前交代过我，让我到上清宗好好修炼，不是写这种东西的。”
“……”宋衍青愣了一下，旋即有些恨铁不成钢道：“修炼也不在乎这一天两天的，写点这个费不了多少时间。”
牛有道一脸天真道：“可我一时半会儿想不起来。”
“……”宋衍青凝噎无语，最终无奈道：“你反正也闲着没什么事，好好想想，想起来了立刻写下来，回头给我看看。”说着将手上纸张小心翼翼卷起。
牛有道貌似奇怪道：“宋师兄，我老师说百无一用是书生，写这个有什么用？”
宋衍青眼皮一抬，一只胳膊与之勾肩搭背道：“小师弟，我自有用处，你想起来后尽管写下来，师兄我亏待不了你。对了，这事不要对其他人说起，明白吗？”一副否则别怪我不客气的样子。
牛有道则绝对是一副对此事不感兴趣的样子，答非所问道：“师兄，我想修炼上清宗的功法，希望能早日像你们一样飞来飞去。”
宋衍青有点不高兴道：“先把我交代的事做好再说！”
牛有道似在耍少年脾气道：“师兄，我闷在这里心烦意乱，保不准哪天就会说漏了嘴。”
宋衍青两眼一眯，冷笑道：“你是在威胁我吗？”
牛有道平静道：“我只是觉得若能早日完成师父的遗愿，也能早日安下心来回忆老师写过的那些诗词，希望能更好的完成师兄的交代。”
宋衍青不禁嘿嘿冷笑，上下审视着牛有道久久不语，发现这位便宜小师弟有点意思，有着超乎年纪的成熟，这是在跟自己谈条件了。话又说回来，若这小师弟写的东西真能帮自己讨师姐欢心的话，答应下来也没什么不可以的，修炼了又如何？不怕这小子能翻天，可问题的关键是，让不让这便宜师弟修炼他也作不了主。
啪！略作斟酌后的宋衍青一掌拍在了牛有道的肩头，抓着他肩膀道：“好，就这么说定了，修炼的事我帮你说说话，问题应该不大，可你记写的东西若是不能让我满意，我保证你没地方后悔去。”倒不是虚言，有些事他虽然做不了主，可宋家对上清宗的影响很大，他真要想办法的话，牛有道修炼的事也不算太难办。
话毕，顺手一推，牛有道咣一声倒地，摔了个狗吃屎。
等牛有道爬起，宋衍青已经大步离去了。疼的呲牙咧嘴的牛有道扯开衣领子，看了看刚才被捏过的肩膀，已经留下了五道青红指印，对方有心给他教训，差点没捏碎他的肩骨，红肿疼痛。
一直以来，牛有道也不想得罪宋衍青给自己找麻烦，尤其是知道了宋衍青的背景，可他历经艰辛来到上清宗是为了什么？好不容易捕捉到了一丝机会，自然是不想错过，忍不住露了些峥嵘冒险一试……
早年的上清宗弟子上万，如今只有数百人，因此居住的宅院很充裕。
回到自己院子，宋衍青迫不及待地进了书房，取了笔墨纸砚，准备将那首词誊抄成自己笔迹时方有些傻眼，忘了问这首词叫什么，遂自己取了个名落笔。

傍晚时分，宋衍青寻入一座幽静山谷，出了山谷翘首张望，目光一定，脸上露出笑容。
前方山脚，两座新起的坟包前，静静伫立着一道婀娜背影，不是别人，正是唐仪。
两座坟包内埋葬着唐牧和司徒浩然这师兄弟两人，上清宗至今搞不清两人究竟出了什么事，但从唐牧的话中品出了事情非同小可，遵唐牧遗言，秘不发丧，连两道墓碑上都没有留名讳。
宋衍青一猜就知道唐仪在此，果不其然，整了整衣冠，快步走了过去，喊了声“师姐”，然后又分别对两座新坟恭恭敬敬作礼。
待其完事，唐仪蹙眉道：“宋师弟来此何干？”
“上次写的诗师姐看不上眼。”转过身来的宋衍青将一卷墨宝双手奉上，乐呵呵道：“这次费尽心思又写了首词，再请师姐鉴赏指教。”
唐仪实在有点不耐烦他的纠缠，她岂能不明白宋衍青存了什么心思，对宋衍青在京城流连风月场所的纨绔事迹也有所耳闻，可如今的上清宗要仰赖宋家，唐素素那边也再三叮嘱了她，不要撕破脸闹得大家都难堪，让她识大局敷衍一二。不管之前这边有没有人埋怨东郭浩然跟商建伯搅和在一起会连累上清宗，可事实是宁王商建伯一死，上清宗如今连最后一道威慑也没了，上清宗已处在风雨飘摇之中，实在是得罪不起宋家。

content_en:
Niu Youdao pointed at his hand. Does that mean it's not there? It must be.
Song Yanqing immediately looked enthusiastic, "Junior brother, quickly write out the poems written by your teacher and appreciate them while you have free time."
Niu Youdao shook his head: "Master told me before he died that I should go to the Shangqing Sect to practice hard. I didn't write this kind of thing."
"..." Song Yanqing was stunned for a moment, and then said, "I don't care about practicing for a day or two. It won't take much time to write something like this."
Niu Youdao said innocently: "But I can't remember it for a while."
"..." Song Yanqing was choked and speechless, and finally said helplessly: "You have nothing to do anyway, think about it carefully, write it down as soon as you remember it, and show it to me later." He carefully rolled up the paper in his hand.
Niu Youdao looked strange and said: "Senior Brother Song, my teacher said that Bai Wuyi is a scholar, what's the use of writing this?"
Song Yanqing raised his eyelids, put an arm around his shoulders and said: "Junior brother, I have my own uses. Just write it down when you think of it. Senior brother, I can't treat you badly. By the way, don't talk about this to other people, understand?" He looked like you wouldn't blame me for being rude otherwise.
Niu Youdao definitely looked like he was not interested in this matter, and answered the question inappropriately: "Brother, I want to practice the Shangqing Sect's techniques, and I hope to be able to fly around like you soon."
Song Yanqing was a little unhappy and said: "First do what I told you and then talk about it!"
Niu Youdao seemed to be playing off his youthful temper and said, "Senior brother, I'm bored here and I'm sure I'll spill the beans one day."
Song Yanqing narrowed his eyes and sneered: "Are you threatening me?"
Niu Youdao said calmly: "I just feel that if I can fulfill Master's last wish as soon as possible, I can also calm down and recall the poems that Master has written. I hope that I can better fulfill Senior Brother's instructions."
Song Yanqing couldn't help but sneer, and looked at Niu Youdao up and down without saying a word for a long time. He found that this cheap junior brother was a bit interesting, and he was mature beyond his years. He was negotiating terms with himself. Then again, if what this young junior brother writes can really help him to please his senior sister, there is nothing wrong with agreeing to it. So what if he practices? I'm not afraid that this kid can change the world, but the key point is that he can't decide whether to let this cheap junior brother practice.
Snap! After some deliberation, Song Yanqing slapped Niu Youdao on the shoulder, grabbed his shoulder and said: "Okay, that's it, I'll help you talk about cultivation. It shouldn't be a big problem, but if you can't let me know what you wrote down, I'm satisfied, and I guarantee you won't regret it." It's not a lie. Although he can't make the decision on some things, the Song family has a great influence on the Shangqing Sect. If he really wants to find a way, Niu Youdao's cultivation is not too difficult.
After finishing his words, he pushed Niu Youdao and Niu Youdao fell to the ground with a thud.
By the time Niu Youdao got up, Song Yanqing had already strode away. Niu Youdao, grinning in pain, pulled open his collar and looked at the shoulder that had been pinched just now. Five green and red fingerprints had been left. The other party wanted to teach him a lesson, but his shoulder bone was almost crushed, and it was red, swollen and painful.
All along, Niu Youdao didn't want to offend Song Yanqing and cause trouble for him, especially after knowing Song Yanqing's background, but why did he come to Shangqing Sect after all the hardships? After finally catching a chance, I naturally didn't want to miss it, so I couldn't help but take a chance...
In the early years, there were tens of thousands of Shangqing Sect disciples, but now there are only a few hundred, so the residences where they live are abundant.
Back in his yard, Song Yanqing couldn't wait to go into the study, took out pen, ink, paper and inkstone, and was about to copy the poem into his own handwriting. When he was a little dumbfounded, he forgot to ask what the poem was called, so he named it and started writing.
In the evening, Song Yanqing found a quiet valley. When he came out of the valley, he looked up with a fixed gaze and a smile on his face.
aheadAt the foot of the mountain, in front of two newly built tombs, a graceful figure stood quietly. It was none other than Tang Yi.
Two senior brothers, Tang Mu and Situ Haoran, were buried in the two tombs. The Shangqing Sect still couldn't figure out what happened to them, but it was clear from Tang Mu's words that the matter was not trivial. In compliance with Tang Mu's last words, the funeral was kept secret and no names were even left on the two tombstones.
Song Yanqing knew Tang Yi was here at the first guess, and sure enough, he straightened his clothes, walked over quickly, called "Senior Sister", and then bowed respectfully to the two new tombs.
After he finished, Tang Yi frowned and said, "What is Junior Brother Song doing here?"
"Senior sister didn't like the poem I wrote last time." Song Yanqing turned around and held up a scroll of calligraphy with both hands, and said cheerfully: "This time I have worked hard to write another poem, and I will ask senior sister for appreciation and advice."
Tang Yi was really a little impatient with his entanglement. How could she not understand what Song Yanqing was thinking? She had also heard about Song Yanqing's dandy deeds in the capital, but now the Shangqing Sect had to rely on the Song family. Tang Susu had repeatedly warned her not to quarrel and embarrass everyone, and let her understand the overall situation and deal with it. Regardless of whether anyone here complained that Dong Guo Haoran and Shang Jianbo getting together would harm the Shangqing Sect, the fact is that with the death of King Ning Shang Jianbo, the Shangqing Sect now has no last deterrent. The Shangqing Sect is already in a precarious situation and cannot afford to offend the Song family.
